summary: Individual integrity pledge template used during the National Dialogue on Corruption to formalize personal commitment to ethical conduct and anti-corruption reporting.
pledge_points: Honesty and transparency in all actions
Fairness, equity, and respect for diversity
Rejection of all forms of corruption and bribery
Ethical decision-making and adherence to law
Fostering a culture of integrity in one's environment
Advocating for transparency and open information
operational_commitment: Specific pledge to report corrupt practices 'without fear or favour'.
